How to request
a ride

From your couch to the curb in five simple steps — or just call us, any hour.

Get started

Enter your pickup and destination in our web booker or app. Choose your car and confirm.

Watch your car arrive

Track your driver live on the map. You'll know exactly when to step outside — even at 4 am.

Meet your driver

Check the unit number on the car. Our drivers are licensed, insured and respectful to every rider.

Enjoy the ride

Clean, non-smoking cars and a driver whose job is to get you there safely and on time.

Pay your way

Pay online in the booker, or with any credit or debit card in the car. Cash works too.

A few words about us

Companies come and go.
We've stood the test of time.

Xpress Ride Cabs provides taxi service across Central Saint Albert — sedans and 5–7 seaters for groups, at the best price in town.

About us

Saint Albert's ride.
Customer first, always.

We provide service 24 hours a day, and taking care of our customers is our No. 1 priority. Even though we're a small organization, we do our best to contribute to the community.

Companies come and go, but our organization has stood the test of time — for good reason.

Xpress Ride Cabs provides taxi service in Central Saint Albert. We offer sedans and 5–7 seater vehicles for groups at the best price across Saint Albert.

Our vehicles and drivers are fully licensed, accredited and insured. We're considered the most reliable transport company for airport transfers and corporate transfers.

We give our team of professional drivers rigorous training and maintain a state-of-the-art service centre to ensure our fleet is safe, reliable and meticulously clean.

Over the years we've delivered satisfying trips for weddings, hens nights, day trips, winery tours, school runs and personal tours — always focused on your needs and your comfort, because we believe in a customer-first policy.
